summary: Vesper is an established, polished cocktail bar on Convent Road in Silom, with a seasonal drinks menu, classics and small plates. It works well as a deliberate evening stop or a starting point for Silom nightlife.
whyGo: The menu balances recognizable classics with inventive seasonal drinks; the current menu includes a Vesper martini and a British-seasons themed selection.
A useful central-Silom location near Sala Daeng BTS and Si Lom MRT makes it easy to combine with dinner or nearby nightlife.
bestFor: Cocktail-focused evenings, date nights, and small groups who enjoy a refined, intimate bar setting.
Visitors who want both alcoholic and zero-alcohol drinks; the current menu lists several 0% options.
skipIf: You want a casual, inexpensive bar, a guaranteed table, or a venue with a relaxed dress policy.
You need step-free access or detailed accessibility information; none was confirmed in the sources checked.
duration: Allow about 1–2 hours for a drink and a small plate; this is a planning estimate, not a venue limit.
cost: Current menu examples are THB 440–690 for cocktails, THB 240–320 for listed zero-alcohol drinks, and THB 240–990 for small plates. Budget roughly THB 500–1,000 per person for one or two drinks before any applicable service charge or tax; confirm the final bill and current menu at the venue.
hours: Official hours: daily 6:30 pm–2:00 am, last order 1:30 am. Check the official hours page again near your visit for holiday changes.
bestTime: Arrive near opening for a better chance of choosing a seat. Late evenings can be busier; this is a practical inference, not a published forecast.
gettingThere: Address: 10/15 Convent Road, Silom, Bangkok 10500. Take the BTS Silom Line to Sala Daeng or the MRT Blue Line to Si Lom, then walk to Convent Road. Taxis and ride-hailing can drop you nearby; traffic in Silom can be slow at peak times. The venue lists parking at Liberty Square.
booking: The official house policy says Vesper is walk-in only and does not take reservations. When full, the venue requires at least one drink per person per hour. For a group or a holiday evening, arrive early and check the venue’s official channels before setting out.
accessibility: No reliable published information on step-free entry, accessible toilets, or other mobility access was found. Contact the venue directly if access needs affect your visit.
practicalTips: Dress smart casual; slippers and athletic wear are not allowed, and entry may be refused for unsuitable attire.
Bring identification; Thailand’s legal drinking age is 20.
Check the menu and house rules on Vesper’s official website shortly before visiting, as hours and offerings can change.
If you do not drink alcohol, the current official menu lists zero-alcohol cocktails and kombucha.
decemberNotes: December is a popular travel period and Christmas/New Year evenings may be especially busy; this is a planning assumption, not a confirmed Vesper event calendar. Since the bar is walk-in only, go early and verify opening hours and any holiday closure notices shortly before your date. No specific December 2026 event was confirmed.
uncertainties: December 2026 opening hours, menu prices, taxes/service charge, and holiday operating dates may change.
Accessibility details were not available from the official pages reviewed.
